title: The Ironwood Sap Flood
story: Deep in the Ironwood Grove, Threnspindle the Sap Bellows has clamped its bellows-belly onto a hollow ironwood tree and is pumping sticky amber sap inside. A family of dormice is huddled on a ledge high in the trunk, and the sap is climbing toward them. Mr 6 jams a hollow bark siphon through the trunk and starts draining sap out the other side.
question: There are 90 gallons of empty space left below the dormice's ledge. Threnspindle pumps sap in at 12.5 gallons per minute while Mr 6's siphon drains 5 gallons per minute. How many minutes does Mr 6 have before the sap reaches the ledge?
solution: The sap really rises by 12.5 - 5 = 7.5 gallons each minute.
Mr 6 has 12 minutes to carry the dormice out.
praise: Working with the rates was exactly right — the missing step was subtracting the siphon's 5 gallons before dividing.
hint: Sap is coming in AND going out. First find how much the level actually gains in one minute.
victory: Mr 6 ferried every dormouse to a high branch with two minutes to spare, and Threnspindle, finding nothing left to flood, deflated with an embarrassed squeak and wheezed off into the trees.
imagePrompt: A bellows-bellied beetle monster pumping glowing amber sap into a huge hollow ironwood tree while a small knightly numeral 6 holds a bark siphon and dormice cling to a ledge above, warm golden forest light.
